review_comment: As I'm [adding those fields to the Elasticsearch specification](https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch-specification/pull/2965), I'm wondering, why do we need underscores here? Under `_ingest`, we already have `timestamp` and `pipeline` that don't use underscores.

Hi @pquentin , to my understanding, underscore is convention for ES managed/populated attributes. For example, [Grok processor](https://www.elastic.co/guide/en/elasticsearch/reference/current/grok-processor.html) adds similar field `_ingest._grok_match_index` with underscore in ingest metadata.
